name: 5-Fluoro-DMT
summary: 5-Fluoro-DMT, or 5-F-DMT, also known as 5-fluoro-N,N-dimethyltryptamine, is a psychedelic drug of the tryptamine family related to dimethyltryptamine (DMT) and to other psychedelic tryptamines like 5-chloro-DMT and 5-bromo-DMT.

pharmacology.text: 5-Fluoro-DMT is known to have affinity for and to act as an agonist of the serotonin 5-HT1A and 5-HT2A receptors.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: 5-Fluoro-DMT was not included nor mentioned in Alexander Shulgin's book TiHKAL (Tryptamines I Have Known and Loved). In 2023, Hamilton Morris described 5-fluoro-DMT as being of increased activity relative to dimethyltryptamine (DMT) in contrast to 5-bromo-DMT and 5-chloro-DMT.

summaryZh: 5-氟-N,N-二甲基色胺是一種色胺衍生物，類似於5-溴二甲基色胺和5-甲氧基二甲基色胺。二甲基色胺的氟取代對其與5-HT2A/C受體的親和性影響不大，但6-氟二乙基色胺對5-HT2A受體的激動性幾乎無效，而4-氟-5-甲基二甲基色胺卻是5-HT1A受體的強激動劑。
summaryZhHans: 5-氟-N,N-二甲基色胺是一种色胺衍生物，类似于5-溴二甲基色胺和5-甲氧基二甲基色胺。二甲基色胺的氟取代对其与5-HT2A/C受体的亲和性影响不大，但6-氟二乙基色胺对5-HT2A受体的激动性几乎无效，而4-氟-5-甲基二甲基色胺却是5-HT1A受体的强激动剂。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the psychedelic tryptamines, can cause nausea, dilated pupils, muscle tension, a faster heartbeat, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences. In people at risk, they can trigger lasting mental health problems such as psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的迷幻色胺類藥物，可能引起噁心、瞳孔放大、肌肉緊繃、心跳加快、焦慮、意識混亂與驚恐的經驗。對本身有風險的人，可能誘發精神病等持久的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的迷幻色胺类药物，可能引起恶心、瞳孔放大、肌肉紧绷、心跳加快、焦虑、意识混乱与惊恐的经验。对本身有风险的人，可能诱发精神病等持久的心理健康问题。

fact.en: Alexander Shulgin did not include it in TiHKAL. Swapping the methoxy group of 5-MeO-DMT for a single fluorine atom leaves a much smaller molecule that still acts on the same receptors.
fact.zh: Alexander Shulgin並未把它收錄在《TiHKAL》中。把5-MeO-DMT的甲氧基換成單一個氟原子，分子小得多，卻仍作用於相同的受體。
fact.zhHans: Alexander Shulgin并未把它收录在《TiHKAL》中。把5-MeO-DMT的甲氧基换成单一个氟原子，分子小得多，却仍作用于相同的受体。
